business_scope.primary_industry_name: Compression Molding of Food-Grade Silicone Tactile Sensory Fidgets

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified commercial system under the Código de Comercio)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (AML/CFT framework and UIAF creation); Ley 1121 de 2007 (terrorist financing prevention); Código de Comercio (SAS incorporation and corporate governance); Decreto 1736 de 2020 and Decreto 1440 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales, mandatory UBO reporting); Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (risk management and due diligence standards)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Good Standing of any non-Colombian corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry or corporations regulator in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Apostille-convention countries) or Consular Legalization (non-convention countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Boilerplate or special Power of Attorney for the designated Colombian representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, followed by notarial consumption before a Colombian Notary (alismado)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Chain Ownership Declaration (beneficial ownership schedule to be attached to SAS documents)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm / responsible party under the UBO Registry rules
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal declaration certified before Colombian notary public; no apostille required for domestic origin documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax Standing Certificate (e.g., Tax ID / Tax Residence Certificate) of individual ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax authority in the owner's country of residence (e.g., IRS, HMRC), or Colombian DIAN for residents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign certificates; date of issuance not older than 90 days

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero) consolidated lists, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, Colombian domestic criminal/terrorist lists, and international PEP databases; enhanced due diligence for any individual categorized as a domestic or foreign PEP, with source-of-funds verification and senior management approval; FATF recommendations 10-12 applied on a risk-sensitive basis; results documented in the pre-incorporation AML/CFT risk file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – managed by Confecámaras and operated through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish and use Latin script; foreign words are accepted only when they are commonly adopted in Spanish commerce or are transliterated to Spanish orthography; the distinct name must be unique and not misleading as to the entity's legal type or real purpose
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Requires prior authorization from the respective ministry or State agency
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within ten (10) business days of written rejection, the applicant must file an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara de Comercio office that rejected the name, and in the alternative a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; the appeal must include the proposed distinct name, a legal brief demonstrating non-conflict with registered marks and compliance with name doctrine, and any preliminary certificates; extension of a reserved name can be requested before expiry only on justifiable grounds, with an additional fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are accepted only as administrative/correspondence support, but the SAS must maintain a physical registered address (domicilio) in Colombia capable of receiving official notifications and court/administrative documents; for this low-risk industrial (compression molding) scope, a standard street address with a registered local agent is sufficient; pure virtual-only configurations do not satisfy the Código de Comercio statutory registered-office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk: an unannounced physical on-site inspection is estimated at <5% annual probability for this industry under normal circumstances, but the Superintendencia de Sociedades, the DIAN, or UIAF may exercise ex officio verification or inspection requests if AML anomalies arise or if the UBO declaration is inconsistent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonymy certificate (Cámara de Comercio)
Notarial protocolization of the SAS bylaws and incorporation acts
Cámara de Comercio commercial registry enrollment and filing fee (no minimum capital, base rate)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on asset/base rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO) report preparation and e-filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm / UBO compliance consultant and DIAN system fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for flat UBO compliance filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille / consular legalization of foreign shareholder documents (estimated two documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs or relevant apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory public fee per document plus forwarding costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening database runs for each beneficial owner
Registered agent / local domicile service for first year
Legal due diligence, UBO matrixing, and pre-incorporation opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk standard corporate formation (flat fee)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008, Art. 1-46 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas) in conjunction with Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Art. 98-141, Decreto 1074 de 2015 (single regulatory decree for commercial registries) and Ley 1429 de 2010 (business formalization incentives).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) portal, with oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) certified before the Chamber of Commerce; notarial escritura pública is required only when real property or assets subject to public registration are contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for S.A.S. under Ley 1258/2008, Art. 5; the constitution instrument fixes subscribed and paid capital, and deferred capital installments may not exceed two years; no escrow account is legally mandated for cash subscriptions, but paid capital must be traceable by bank transfer and recorded in the incorporation document.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1: The incorporators, having subscribed and paid the initial share capital, adopt the bylaws and proceed. FIRST: The subscribed shares are formally acknowledged and issued to each subscriber. SECOND: The registered office at [City, address] is adopted as the principal domicile of the Company. THIRD: Appointment of the legal representative; a revisor fiscal shall be appointed if statutory thresholds are reached, otherwise the position is waived. FOURTH: The legal representative is authorized to execute the Chamber of Commerce registration, the DIAN RUT enrollment, and open the corporate bank account. FIFTH: The Company elects the simplified annual reporting regime. Resolution unanimously approved and certified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability and Homonymy Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES platform of the selected Chamber of Commerce, enter up to three proposed company names, and request the Certificado de Homonimia; the system flags coincidences with existing registered commercial names; upon clearance the name is reserved for a maximum of thirty days and the reservation ticket is appended to the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Photographic ID or immigration document of each incorporator
List of up to three proposed corporate names
NIT or personal document number of each shareholder
Contact email address and telephone
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name collides with a pre-existing registration, file a fresh name request through RUES or submit written argument to the Chamber Registrar for comparative analysis; the name can be cured by adding a distinguishing element and re-presenting the reservation within the thirty-day term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Constitution Instrument and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (optional authentication) and founding shareholders jointly
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the documento privado de constitución containing the mandatory clauses of Ley 1258/2008: corporate name, domicile, duration, corporate object (ISIC 3240 silicone compression molding), subscribed and paid capital, administrative structure, representation powers, fiscal year, and audit provisions; authenticate signatures before a notary or certify them with valid digital certificates under Colombian electronic signature rules.
required_dossiers: Draft constitution instrument and complete bylaws
Valid identification and NIT of each subscribing shareholder
Proof of payment of subscribed capital into a provisional bank account
Acceptance letters of the proposed legal representative and auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a formal objection, correct the instrument and re-execute; alternatively, execute the constitution entirely through the RUES digital channel with certified electronic signatures, which bypasses notarial intervention for cash-only contributions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed constitution instrument with the RUES registration form and pay the registration tariff calculated on declared capital, plus the 0.7% registry tax on contributions; the Chamber registers the company and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal together with the matrícula mercantil of the business establishment.
required_dossiers: Signed and authenticated constitutional document
RUES business registration form
Receipt of registration tariff and registry tax
Shareholders' identification copies
Certificado de Homonimia reservation ticket
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a defect requirement (requerimiento de corrección), cure the formal deficiency within the granted deadline; if the objection persists, file a recurso de reposición before the Chamber Registrar, with a final queja petition to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN (NIT, RUT and Electronic Invoicing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the S.A.S. in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through the DIAN electronic portal or service points to obtain the NIT; declare the manufacturing tax profile (IVA at 19% on sales, ICA municipal tax) and activate the factura electrónica module with software certification per DIAN Resolution 000012/2021; Chamber data transfers automatically to DIAN to accelerate enrollment.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT pre-enrollment form generated by DIAN system
Bylaws and legal representative appointment minutes
Proof of registered office address (lease deed or ownership title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN assigns an incorrect tax classification, file a rectification through the RUT electronic update module attaching the Chamber certificate and bylaws; if electronic invoicing certification is rejected, resubmit the technical and security validation documents or pursue administrative reconsideration before DIAN.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account and Mandatory Social Security Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized credit institution (commercial bank) and Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), EPS, and AFP operators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account by presenting the legal representation certificate, RUT, and the bank signature authorization minutes; enroll the legal representative and employees through the PILA system with an ARL in the appropriate occupational risk class for compression molding, an EPS for health coverage, and an AFP for pension.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT issued by DIAN
Identification and background documentation of final beneficial owners
Bylaws extract confirming representation powers
Utility bill of the registered office and bank application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced KYC/AML documentation, provide the economic activity declaration, corporate group structure chart, and share register; unresolved queries may be escalated to the bank compliance committee, or the account may be opened at another authorized financial intermediary and reported to DIAN via RUT update.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Book Legitimization and Superintendencia Filing Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (book legalization) and Superintendencia de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the corporate books (shareholders and board meeting minutes book, share subscription register, and financial books) to the Chamber for the registro de libros timestamp; thereafter satisfy the annual obligation to submit financial statements and management reports to the Superintendencia de Sociedades through the SIRE digital platform at fiscal year-end.
required_dossiers: Minutes book and share register to be legalized
Bylaws and founding meeting minutes
Annual financial statements for the SIRE filing
Final beneficial owner registry report if thresholds apply
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber refuses book legalization, correct the formal defects and re-present; if the Superintendencia queries the financial statement filing, respond through the SIRE system within ten business days with adjusted statements and supporting corrections, or request an extension before preclusion.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for toy technical regulation enforcement; municipal Mayor's Office (Alcaldía) as the industrial operating license window; Curaduría Urbana for building and structural permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Uso de Suelo y Licencia de Funcionamiento Industrial (municipal land-use and industrial operating permit) together with Certificado de Conformidad del Reglamento Técnico de Juguetes (SIC, based on ISO 8124 series) for the silicone fidget toys; no special sectoral license is imposed on this low-risk novelty toy manufacturing activity beyond general commercial registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) with jurisdiction at the plant site (e.g., CAR de Cundinamarca or the territorial environmental authority of the municipality); ANLA reserved only for projects exceeding national environmental licensing thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-impact environmental registration and specific permitting category, not a Full EIA Report: the facility must obtain the Registro de Vertimientos (wastewater discharge permit), the Registro de Emisiones Atmosféricas (stationary source emissions register for VOCs), and the Registro de Generador de Residuos before the CAR.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal collectors must comply with Resolution 0631/2015 thresholds: pH 6.0-9.0, COD maximum 1200 mg/L, BOD5 maximum 600 mg/L, total suspended solids maximum 600 mg/L, and fats and oils maximum 20 mg/L; atmospheric VOC emissions from silicone compression molding and curing vents must meet the stationary source limits of Resolution 909/2008, with fugitive emission capture efficiency above 95% and particulate matter below 50 mg/Nm3; cross-linked silicone scraps and catalyst residues are managed as special wastes per Decree 4741/2005 and Resolution 1164/2002.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate) evidencing compliance with Decree 1072/2015 Chapter 6 on fire prevention, extinguishing means, and evacuation conditions; structural load and seismic-resistance review certificate for the industrial building per NSR-10 and Law 400/1997 issued through the Curaduría Urbana; workplace safety and health program (SG-SST) registered with the ARL and subject to Ministry of Labor inspection; for the food-grade silicone claim, municipal health secretary sanitary authorization or INVIMA food-contact material certification of the molding compound.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Full official name of national tax authority and portal

mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la Republica de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), which administers the International Exchange Control Regime (Regimen de Cambios Internacionales) under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993 and Decree 1068 of 2015. Day-to-day channeling and declaration duties are performed exclusively through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMCs), primarily commercial banks supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC). The exchange-control sub-agencies may also act under the central bank's authorization for specific non-bank transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a free-floating exchange-rate regime with no multi-tiered currency system. Both current-account and capital-account operations are freely convertible, but the S.A.S. must comply with the mandatory channeling obligation (canalizacion) of all foreign-currency payments through an IMC and must file the corresponding Exchange Declarations (Declaraciones de Cambio). Current-account flows such as export proceeds, service fees and royalties are remittable without prior authorization. Capital-account flows, including inbound equity injections, must be registered with Banco de la Republica under Form 4 (Declaracion de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) to secure the legal right to later repatriate dividends, reduce capital and remit liquidation proceeds. Profit remittance is permitted conditioned on: (i) the foreign investment registration; (ii) the channeling of the dividend payment via an IMC; and (iii) compliance with Colombian dividend withholding tax rules. There are no exchange-rate conversion quotas; the system measures convertibility through channeling and documentation rather than quantitative controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For Colombian exporters of goods (including food-grade silicone tactile fidgets classified under ISIC 3240), the foreign-currency proceeds from the export must be channeled through the foreign-exchange market within the surrender term stated in the export declaration, subject to a maximum term of six months calculated from the date of shipment/export. The exporter may request a one-time extension of up to an additional six months for justified collection reasons, subject to IMC approval. There is no mandatory conversion ratio into Colombian pesos; the exporter may either sell the currency to the IMC, maintain the proceeds in a foreign-currency checking or savings account with an IMC, or use the funds to settle authorized foreign currency obligations. The mandatory documentary compliance includes filing Form 2 (Declaracion de Cambio por Exportaciones) with the IMC, together with the definitively accepted export declaration (DEX), the transport document and the commercial invoice. Failure to channel within the deadline gives rise to exchange-control fines (multas cambiaras) and may trigger adverse risk-rating by the SFC.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low as a primary local banking rail; Medium as an ancillary international receivable-collection corridor for platform-pay flows. Legal Constraints: non-Colombian electronic-money institutions (EMIs) are not IMCs under Colombian exchange-control law and therefore cannot be used as the exclusive repository of the S.A.S.'s export proceeds without violating the channeling obligation. EMIs cannot process DIAN tax payments, cannot serve as payroll or commercial clearing accounts in Colombia, and are not permitted to hold the S.A.S.'s regulatory capital or to be named as bank reference in foreign investment registration filings. Where a payment platform (e.g., global e-commerce settlement) transfers funds through an EMI, the S.A.S. must bring those funds into Colombia through an IMC within the surrender timeline and must annex the platform settlement statement to the Form 2 exchange declaration. The prudent treasury design is therefore: local IMC operational and escrow accounts as the primary rails, with the EMI used solely for marketplace settlement before channeling, and never as residual balance holder beyond the regulatory term.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian SFC anti-money-laundering rules (Circular Basica Juridica, Title IV) require financial institutions to apply rigorous customer due diligence for corporate clients, including personal identification of signatories and beneficial owners. For a foreign-owned S.A.S., strict physical presence is generally mandated in practice: at least one legal representative, or an Altamira-appointed agent with full powers, must attend a live KYC interview at the bank branch or with a bank-designated notary, because the corporate certificate issued by the Cámara de Comercio must be authenticated against the identity of the appearing party. Remote onboarding is technically permitted where the SFC-approved digital identity and biometric authentication solution recognizes a valid Colombian cédula, but foreign passport holders normally cannot complete the entire pipeline virtually. The recommended structure is: (i) execute before a Colombian notary a special power of attorney designating a Colombia-resident individual (or the local legal representative) to appear for the interview; (ii) apostille and legalize the foreign-issued incorporation documents and powers of attorney; and (iii) allow a 4-to-8-week onboarding window to accommodate notarial, commercial-registry and compliance-review delays.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) with no Colombian identity documentation or local tax ID.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled passports of every natural-person UBO; notarized corporate constitutional documents and by-laws translated into Spanish; the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio no more than 30 days prior to onboarding; a sworn UBO declaration identifying all direct and indirect shareholders with 5% or more participation and the full control chain; a signed corporate-organization chart; and, where a parent entity exists, audited financial statements of the parent for the last fiscal year.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of Funds on the initial foreign capital injection (USD/EUR wire) lacking transactional clarity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly executed capital-subscription minutes and formal capital-call notice; remitting shareholder's bank statements covering not less than six months preceding the wire; source-of-wealth statement supported by investor tax returns or audited financials; declaration that the funds are unencumbered and originated from a regulated financial institution; and an investment commitment letter describing the intended use of proceeds for silicone fidget-toy tooling, food-grade raw materials and working capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, OFAC or PEP screening false positive triggered by a substantially similar Latin surname or board member name.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the passport biometric page; national identity card displaying full name, date and place of birth; notarial certificate of name uniqueness; a signed clarification letter mapping the screening hit and confirming the entity chain of ownership, along with a legal-entity chart; where applicable, evidence of PEP status or the absence of any current PEP relationship; recommended compliance-lead-time buffer of six weeks before funding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Platform-pay receivables (e-commerce marketplace, payment-aggregator or digital wallet) received from multiple foreign jurisdictions not matching export declarations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed marketplace or payment-aggregator agreement; platform settlement statements reconciled against export invoices; export declarations (DEX) and customs transport documents for the corresponding shipment lots; Form 2 exchange declarations filed with the IMC; and a documented arm's-length pricing policy per unit of fidget product to support the bank's transaction-narrative review.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder's equity injection must be executed through the following compliant protocol: (i) formalize the capital increase or initial subscription in the S.A.S. corporate minutes and register the economic rights with the Cámara de Comercio; (ii) request the local IMC to register the capital contribution under the foreign direct investment category and obtain the Form 4 pre-registration or digital registration with Banco de la Republica; (iii) instruct the remitting bank abroad to send the USD/EUR wire via SWIFT MT103 with the payment narrative referencing the S.A.S. NIT and 'foreign direct investment - capital subscription'; (iv) upon receipt, the IMC will credit the foreign currency or convert it into COP and the S.A.S. must file the corresponding Exchange Declaration within the statutory window (normally the month following the operation) so that the investment yields full repatriation rights; (v) maintain in the permanent archive the MT103 confirmation, the IMC exchange declaration, the notarized corporate documents, the shareholder register and the Cámara de Comercio certificate. The purpose code used on the declaration must align with manufacturing of food-grade silicone articles (ISIC 3240), and the source-of-funds veracity will be attested by the IMC's compliance unit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imports of food-grade silicone, pigments, molds and equipment, the primary clearing rails are: (i) SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for open-account supplier payments, with the payment narrative quoting the DIAN import declaration number, commercial invoice and LC reference where applicable, and with the mandatory Form 1 exchange declaration filed at the IMC for goods imports; (ii) irrevocable documentary commercial letters of credit (sight or short-term usance) issued through the IMC for high-value or strategic supplier relationships, subject to UCP 600, where the clearing executes against presentation of transport document, commercial invoice, insurance and certificates of analysis; and (iii) the debt-only SWIFT rail for service fees, design royalties and testing costs, filed under Form 3. All outbound disbursements must be corroborated by underlying trade documentation and reconciled against the registered foreign-investment corridor to avoid exchange-control penalties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable outright forwards (Forwards) with tenors up to 24 months, executed through an IMC to hedge export receivables, import payables and the working capital cycle of the S.A.S.
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) available for clients with genuine underlying foreign-currency exposure, settled in COP as a net differential under an ISDA or local master agreement.
COP/USD cross-currency swaps (CCS) for long-dated alignment between USD-denominated shareholder loans or equity injections and COP operating liquidity.
FX swaps (swap de moneda extranjera) to bridge temporary COP/USD liquidity mismatches at the same value date or short tenors within the IMC treasury line.
Foreign-currency call and put options permitted for hedging the same underlying economic commitments, subject to IMC risk approval and a board-approved derivatives policy of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce) in the jurisdiction of the S.A.S.'s registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal penalty set by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), calculated on assets/liabilities; persistent failure to renew can subject the entity to administrative removal or enforced cancellation from the commercial registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting minutes approving financial statements (Acta de Asamblea de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio for registration/deposit of minutes and financial statements; Superintendencia de Sociedades if the S.A.S. is under its supervisory remit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual shareholders' meeting must be held by 31 March; minutes and financial statements must be filed with the Chamber of Commerce within 30 days after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit may trigger registration surcharges and fines by the SIC; continued omission impairs corporate standing and blocks certificates of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementario)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, by the individual deadline assigned under DIAN resolution for each taxpayer's NIT, generally between April and May following the tax year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extension filing penalty: 5% of tax payable per month or fraction, subject to caps, plus late-payment interest at DIAN rates; failure to file can lead to official assessment and administrative enforcement measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO report (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Beneficiario Final registry platform) and, when applicable, cross-agency information exchange
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within ten working days after the ordinary deadline for filing the annual income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Breach is subject to DIAN monetary sanctions under Law 2155/2021; fines may reach thousands of COP (up to approximately USD 35,000) depending on assets and reiteration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if on 31 December of the previous year its gross assets or gross income exceed 3,000 minimum monthly wages (SMLMV) or if shareholders' equity or headcount crosses certain statutory thresholds; otherwise independent audit is not compulsory solely on entity size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian NIIF (IFRS) under Law 1314/2009, Decretos 2420/2015 and 2496/2015; small and medium S.A.S. apply IFRS for SMEs (estándar para Pymes) unless they opt into full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Any transfer of shares must be reflected in the share register and in the annual UBO filing to DIAN; the S.A.S. must annually confirm and update the final beneficial owner details within 10 working days after the corporate income tax return deadline, even if no ownership change occurred.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US $250 to $700 per annum for registered office and local agent representation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US $1,000 to $3,500 for a typical independent audit or Revisor Fiscal engagement

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Article 240 ET; applicable for fiscal years 2024 and 2025; no sectoral surcharge for ISIC 3240)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 35% flat rate; optional SIMPLE regime (Art. 903-916 ET) with progressive 2%-12% combined rates for industrial/manufacturing SMEs with gross income ≤ 100,000 UVT, although foreign-owned SAS with non-resident corporate shareholders are generally excluded; zero-rated VAT for exports (Art. 481 ET) with refundable input credits; 25% income-tax credit for investments in science, technology and innovation (Art. 256 ET); 12-year NOL carryforward (Art. 309 ET).
